NEXprint Free Module

Dark Mode Backend

Transform your Odoo backend with an elegant dark theme that reduces eye strain and boosts productivity during extended work sessions.

KEY FEATURES

01

One-Click Activation

Enable dark mode from Settings with a single click. Fully compatible with all native Odoo modules and third-party apps.

02

Professional Palette

Carefully curated dark colors (#1a1a2e, #16213e, #0f3460) that meet WCAG contrast and accessibility standards.

03

Full View Compatibility

Works seamlessly with Kanban, List, Form, Pivot, Graph, Calendar and Dashboard views without breaking existing styles.

04

Zero Performance Impact

Uses native CSS custom properties to switch themes without page reload. Lightweight SCSS injection only.

TECHNICAL SPECS
▶ Injects compiled SCSS stylesheet via web.assets_backend asset bundle
▶ Overrides Odoo CSS variables: --o-brand-primary, --o-bg-color, --o-webclient-background-color
▶ Does NOT modify any Python models or XML views
▶ Guaranteed compatibility with future Odoo updates and OCA modules
HOW IT WORKS
1 Install the module from Apps
2 Navigate to Settings → User Interface
3 Enable NEXprint Dark Mode toggle
4 Theme applies instantly across all browser sessions
